podcast.body: This was an old Eddie Cochran song performed by Sid Vicious and The Vicious White Kids at their one show at the Electric Ballroom in London. It was dedicated to Nancy Spungen, highlighting his connection to her even in his musical efforts. "Sid Vicious and the Vicious White Kids doing the old studio song, a one-up of your dog dedicated to Nancy, no less."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
